aso.subtitle: Mah Jongg Tournament & League
aso.promotional_text: Run Mah Jongg tournaments, leagues & classes. Registration, scoring, leaderboards, raffles, and club management — all in one app.
aso.description:
Morain Mahj is the all-in-one platform for American Mah Jongg tournament, league, and class management.

Designed for directors, club organizers, and players of the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL), Morain Mahj handles every aspect of running and participating in Mah Jongg events:

• TOURNAMENT MANAGEMENT — Create tournaments with custom flights, player caps, and waitlists. Automated table assignments with East player verification. Real-time scorekeeping with support for negative scores. Live leaderboards and prize tracking.

• LEAGUE MANAGEMENT — Run seasonal leagues with session scheduling, RSVP management, automated table assignments, player rankings, and prize payouts. Members can RSVP, view assignments, and track standings from their phone.

• CLASSES & COURSES — Instructors can create multi-lesson courses, enroll students, schedule lessons, share teaching materials, and manage waitlists.

• PLAYER FEATURES — View your tournament history, track your stats and rankings, receive push notifications for check-in opens and table assignments, and access your scorecard in real time.

• RAFFLES & SILENT AUCTIONS — Run 50/50 draws, T-raffles, general raffles, and silent auctions with live running totals and winner selection.

• CLUB & ORGANIZATION MANAGEMENT — White-label branding, multi-organizer support, broadcast communications, and community feed with moderation tools.

• PUBLIC WEBSITES — Every tournament, league, and course gets its own customizable public website with registration, schedules, sponsors, and gallery.

KEYWORDS: mah jong, mahjong, mah jongg, American Mahjong, NMJL, National Mah Jongg League, tournament management, league management, scoring, leaderboards, player rankings, club management.

Morain Mahj supports NMJL rules with tournament-level and custom rule variants. Whether you're running a casual club night or a large-scale tournament, Morain Mahj makes it effortless.
